title: Prop 15.256 global ∑μ and (κ,φ) extension sums; residual (i) OPEN on vanishing / reflection

sum_mu.theorem: Under bal pairwise + 3-wise vanish and Q≡±p on Max±: ∑_S μ(S)=−p²(p²−1)/12.  Proof: E[Q²]=p²=binom(n,2)+6∑μ (wedges die); equivalently E[(1ᵀy)⁴]=n+3n(n−1)+24∑μ with E[(1ᵀy)⁴]=p⁴+6p²+1.

ext_kappa.theorem: Normalised Paley (finite row-sum 1): for S={∞,a,b,c}, ∑_{j∉S} κ({j,a,b,c})=3−κ0² with κ0=C_ab+C_ac+C_bc.  On |κ0|=1 the sum equals 2.

ext_phi.theorem: Normalised Paley: ∑_{j∉S} φ({j,a,b,c})=p²+P with P=(κ0²−3)/2.  On |κ0|=1: ∑φ=p²−1.  Proof: expand ∑_r C_ra C_rb C_rc(row_r−C_r∞−∑_{u∈{a,b,c}}C_ru); C² kills cross pairs; φ(S)=τ₃−1.

f4_ext.theorem: On |κ0|=1, the f4-extension sum equals (9−p²)/(p n)≠0 for p≥5.  Hence local vanishing ∑μ_ext=0 cannot hold for μ=f4 on all extensions; the |κ|=3 layer must cancel (structure).

hinge.open: Prove ∑_{j∉S} μ=0 on |κ0|=1 (⇔ m₄⁺=m₄⁻), or reflection |ρ|≤|ρ_f4|, or Es4/ker=sc/hull.  Global ∑μ and (κ,φ) extension sums do not force local vanishing.

F3: ∑_S μ=−p²(p²−1)/12 proved Max+-free.  Extension ∑κ=3−κ0² and ∑φ=p²+P proved on normalised Paley.  f4-extension sum (9−p²)/(pn)≠0 so local vanishing needs |κ|=3 cancellation.  Census OK p=5,7.  Vanishing / reflection / residual-(i) still OPEN.  No predicate flip.
